note: Searched ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web for Haskell County OK (FIPS 40061) parcel services. No county-published parcel polygon service or file was found. The only statewide parcel layer (OK Maps Statewide Parcels, from county assessor rolls) is view-only via OGC WMS, not downloadable or queryable as features, and does not clearly include Haskell County. Haskell's assessor search is a vendor-hosted property search (usassessor / actDataScout; the latter returned HTTP 403) with no public parcel polygon service. Commercial vendors (Dynamo, Regrid, Rockford) sell parcel files but are not county services.
